note: Twelve interleaved pairs on one host. The same null broker served both runtimes. The parent starts the leader connection inside the measured phase and records 1 to 3 QueueFull retries. The candidate flushes one record before the census so that connection already exists, and the broker end-offset audit subtracts that record. Every run acknowledged 20,000 measured records and matched the high watermark. The candidate recorded 0 QueueFull retries. The paired mean records/s ratio is 1.257 and the bootstrap 95% CI is 1.145 to 1.384. No pair was slower. This is a harness correction, not a library change, not a peer comparison, and not a KL09-70 claim.
